== Summary ==
[[Joe Boulden]], Decipher digital illustrator, behind a model of the Enterprise-D, from Richard Handley's ''Star Trek Communicator'' article on how Decipher made ''Star Trek'' CCG card art. The printed caption reads: "Maybe a little TOO much time staring at those image details there, Joe ... !" Photo: Decipher.

== Source ==
* [[Richard Handley|Rich Handley]], "Rec Deck: Creating the Star Trek CCG", ''Star Trek Communicator'' 138 (2002), Decipher, pp. 72–74; photograph on p. 74. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/star-trek-communicator-issue-138/page/n77/mode/1up Internet Archive] (leaf n77). The Internet Archive item is itself the preserved copy.
* Cropped from the page scan to the photograph only (box 920,2008 to 2361,2920 of the 2361×3167 leaf).
* Identification: the article is an interview with Joe Boulden, "a digital illustrator and animator among Decipher's pool of designers", and the caption on his photograph addresses him as Joe.

== Licensing ==
Non-free. Fair-use rationale: one reduced photograph from a page of a Decipher-published magazine, used only to identify Joe Boulden on his article on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the magazine or harm its market.
